title: Steer mid-turn

steps.post: @{agent} read every monthly minutes page linked from {FIX}/minutes/ and give me a table of every month's approved expenditure with a total.

steps.command: /collegium steer Change of plan: I only need the grand total and the single largest month, no table.

groundTruth.spec: §7.5 steer hands one instruction to the running turns, read before the next completion, arriving as the person speaking with their name; it discards a completion in flight and spends one attempt; the preamble says a handed instruction arrives in the same form as a post between results

pass: The steer text appears in the turn's events as an instruction from the person (with their name) between tool results; the reply gives the total $78,565 and September 2025 at $15,220 and no month-by-month table; the turn continued from the pages already read rather than restarting.

checks.text: events.json holds the steer text attributed to the person, after at least one tool result.
The reply holds the two figures and no table; both figures are correct.
Pages fetched before the steer were not fetched again after it (economy under a change of plan).
The status post shows the steer (a line or mark) so a watcher can tell the plan changed; record how it appears.
